- make pauses between meals, letting food to go out of your stomach. Different food demands different time, but our app will  show you digestion time of chosen foods and even notify you when you can eat something again!

- Drink water, as much as you can. But don't remember to stop drinking 10 minutes before eating and start again not earlier than 20 minutes after. Otherwise, water and food will contradict each other.
